desc:
Welcome to Save Our Forest! 🌳

A devastating wildfire is spreading across the forest, putting countless wild animals in danger! Can you extinguish the flames, restore the forest, and protect the wildlife before it's too late? 

💧 Extinguish fires to save the forest!
🪓 Chop down burned trees and collect logs!
🪵 Sell logs to earn Coins!
🛠️ Buy better tools and upgrade your equipment!
📈 Become stronger with powerful tools and upgrades!
🐾 Find and rescue endangered wild animals hidden throughout the forest!
🏆 Explore, progress, and become the ultimate forest rescuer!

🌲 Every tree you save and every orangutan you rescue makes a difference!

👍 Like & Favorite for future updates!
